# EU Succession Extension

European succession rules: Brussels IV choice of law and European Certificate of Succession, Spanish regional regimes, forced heirship variants across civil law traditions, and post-Brexit UK asset handling.

Source: [`v3/extensions/eu-succession/eu-succession.json`](../../../../v3/extensions/eu-succession/eu-succession.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/extensions/eu-succession/eu-succession.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `memberState` | `string` | yes | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the EU member state whose succession rules apply — determines Brussels IV regulation applicability |
| `brusselsIV` | [BrusselsIVChoiceOfLaw](#def-BrusselsIVChoiceOfLaw) | | |
| `europeanCertificate` | [EuropeanCertificateOfSuccession](#def-EuropeanCertificateOfSuccession) | | |
| `spanishRegionalRegime` | [SpanishRegionalRegime](#def-SpanishRegionalRegime) | | |
| `forcedHeirshipVariant` | [ForcedHeirshipVariant](#def-ForcedHeirshipVariant) | | |
| `postBrexitHandling` | [PostBrexitAssetHandling](#def-PostBrexitAssetHandling) | | |
| `legislativeChanges` | array of `object` | | |
| `notes` | `string` | | |

Also accepts properties whose names match `^x-inherit-[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,54}$`.
